messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout v4.2.1 -> 5% traffic to us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Change window: 03:30-05:30 UTC. Rolling checks: health + error-rate for 15m. Release notes: <internal/release/4.2.1>

hana: FYI the client-lib bump (1.8.0 -> 1.9.0) is in this release. It changes header encoding for gzip responses. Keeping an eye on any 4xx spikes.

javier: Seeing a small increase in 400s on us-east the last 8m: baseline 0.03% -> 0.45%. Sample traces show "invalid-accept-encoding" from edge-proxy when rehydrating cache.

emily: I can reproduce locally by using client-lib 1.9.0 against edge-proxy with gzip negotiation toggled. Fails when Accept-Encoding contains multiple values.

javier: Also noticing client-side retry rate doubled which is amplifying load to auth and kv. Might be small but self-amplifying.

hana: Proposal: hold ramp to 10%, pin us-east traffic back to v4.2.0 while we hotfix client-lib and add tolerant header parsing. Can we do pin instead of full rollback?

rupert: +1 to pin. Pin avoids rolling back other regions and keeps deploy progress in eu-west if healthy. But we should pause auto-ramp globally until safe.

oncall-bot: @rupert, @javier — oncall is rupert. Pager notified.

rupert: Oncall ack. Quick triage: is this client-only or server parsing? If server parsing change is required we should hotfix server. If client is at fault we can pin server while we coordinate with client releases.

emily: Root cause: client-lib now sends header like: "Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate" joined differently; edge-proxy parser strict check fails for comma-separated tokens with whitespace. Server should be tolerant. Patch trivial.

javier: I have a short patch to accept whitespace; testing now. If tests pass we can ship hotfix and then unpin.

hana: Runbook actions: 1) Pause further percent increases; 2) pin us-east to v4.2.0; 3) start hotfix PR for edge-proxy tolerant header parsing; 4) smoke test on staging; 5) resume a controlled 2% canary in us-east after validation.

emily: Commands:
```
# pause rollout
deployctl rollout pause --version=4.2.1 --strategy=percent
# pin region
deployctl pin --version=4.2.0 --routes=us-east-1 --reason="client-lib header parsing 400s"
```

hana: Approve. Execute both. :thumbsup:⁠

rupert: Executing now. Will post deployctl output.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by rupert (exec-20260323-990). No further percent increases will be applied.

deploy-bot: Pins applied: us-east-1 -> v4.2.0.

rupert: Pin confirmed. Creating incident INC-20260323-78 and assigning to emily & javier for the hotfix.

emily: PR opened: edge-proxy#1421 (tolerant header parsing). Running unit + integration tests. ETA ~20m.

javier: Staging smoke test plan: run 50k small requests with client-lib 1.9.0 and verify 4xx rate <0.05% for 30m. I'll start once CI green.

hana: Ops note: update release notes and product that us-east was pinned; eu-west remains at 5% but we should watch.

emily: CI passed. Merging hotfix and kicking a canary deploy to staging.

javier: Staging smoke started at 03:52 UTC. Early numbers look clean — 4xx ~0.01%. Continuing 30m run.

hana: If staging stays clean, propose unpinning us-east and resuming a gradual 2% canary first, then continue normal ramp. Better to reintroduce slowly.

rupert: Agreed. After staging green: unpin -> resume to 2% -> observe 15m -> proceed. I'll coordinate the unpin command.

emily: Note for postmortem: add an integration test that combines client-lib 1.9 and edge-proxy header parsing to catch whitespace delimiters.

javier: Staging green at 04:22 UTC. 4xx stayed <0.02%. Ready for unpin and cautious re-intro.

hana: Ok to proceed with unpin + 2% canary. rupert please run commands.

rupert: Running unpin and small ramp. Commands: 
```
# remove pin
deployctl unpin --routes=us-east-1 --reason="hotfix merged, staging verified"
# resume to 2%
deployctl rollout resume --version=4.2.1 --to-percent=2 --strategy=percent
```

deploy-bot: Pin removed by rupert (exec-20260323-991).

deploy-bot: Rollout resumed: v4.2.1 -> 2% traffic (us-east-1 added)

javier: Monitoring: first 6m of the 15m check: 4xx stable at 0.02%, retries normal, no auth/backpressure.

hana: Continue to 15m check. If any regression >0.2% or spike in retries, we stop and revert.

emily: Notifying SDK owners to cut a follow-up client patch to be more conservative about header formatting, but server fix is in place so not blocking.

rupert: After 15m hold with green metrics, plan to resume normal ramp to 10% and continue per rollout policy. I'll mark this call as STOP (stop for now) then GO when we reach 15m green.

javier: 15m check complete, metrics green. No abnormality.

rupert: GO to continue ramp to 10%. execute: `deployctl rollout continue --version=4.2.1 --to-percent=10`

deploy-bot: Rollout scaled to 10% by rupert (exec-20260323-992).

hana: Closing notes: STOP when issue detected, pin region to stable, hotfix, staging smoke, unpin + 2% canary, then resume. Postmortem to include improved cross-client integration tests and a checklist for client-lib bumps.

emily: Updating release notes and sending a short note to product & SDK teams.

deploy-bot: Thread closed. For urgent follow-ups reopen or @rupert.
